title: Alert when a transfer fails or is reversed
summary: When a Paystack transfer fails or is reversed, text the owner and email the accountant at once.
description: Whenever Paystack reports that a transfer you sent failed or was reversed, texts the owner and emails the accountant the reference, amount and reason, at the same time, so someone can retry or contact the recipient. Phone and email are the tenant variables owner_phone and accountant_email.

variables.name: owner_phone
variables.why: The owner's phone number in international format without +.

params.name: paystack_connection
params.title: Paystack connection
params.description: The Paystack connection whose webhooks start this workflow.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

params.name: gmail_connection
params.title: Gmail connection
params.description: The mailbox the email is sent from.

definition.name: Alert when a transfer fails or is reversed

output.text: ='Paystack transfer ' + trigger.body.data.reference + ' ' + (trigger.event == 'transfer.reversed' ? 'was REVERSED' : 'FAILED') + ': NGN ' + string(double(trigger.body.data.amount) / 100.0) + (has(trigger.body.data.reason) && trigger.body.data.reason != '' ? ' (' + trigger.body.data.reason + ')' : '')

steps.name: Tell the owner and the accountant
